record.paper: Temporalizing digraphs via linear-size balanced bi-trees

dossier_meta.paper: Temporalizing digraphs via linear-size balanced bi-trees
dossier_meta.statement_text: What is the maximum $c_{b}$ for which every strongly connected directed graph on $n$ vertices has a balanced bi-tree of size at least $c_{b}.n$?
dossier_meta.context_text: The paper proves $c_{b}\geq 1/3$ (Theorem 4), where both the out-tree $|T^{+}|$ and in-tree $|T^{-}|$ of the bi-tree each have size at least $n/6$. The exact optimal constant $c_{b}$ is unknown.
